content: The average person walks the equivalent of three times around the world in a lifetime.
A blue whale's heart is so big that a human could swim through its arteries.
A duck's quack doesn't echo, and no one knows why.
Most laughter tracks in TV sitcoms were recorded in the 1950s. Many of the people you hear laughing are dead.
Botanically speaking, bananas are berries, while strawberries are not.
In Switzerland, it is illegal to own just one guinea pig because they are social animals and suffer from loneliness.
There are more possible iterations of a game of chess than there are atoms in the observable universe.
There is enough iron in the human body to make a small nail.
